name: Tacking in the zone
note: Quiz #4. Boat 1 is close-hauled on starboard, fetching the windward mark (left to port), on starboard since she entered the zone. Boat 0 comes in on port and tacks onto starboard inside the zone, just ahead of boat 1, and is slow out of the tack; boat 1 has to luff above close-hauled. The boat that tacked in the zone (boat 0) breaks rule 18.3 and takes the penalty, although she is clear ahead after the tack.
